newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 26.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Though the military is now in a position to crush Tamil Tiger rebels (LTTE), social and political problems of the minority should be solved by advancing the political process, says Deputy Defence Minister General Anuruddha Ratwatte. The militry launched 'Operation Jaya Sikuru' into the rebel-held Wanni two weeks ago.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga is on two-day official visit to Kuwait to boost trade, investment and diplomatic links, officials said.
Troops of Operation Jaya Sikuru capture Rambaikulam, about one mile north of Omanthai, after fierce clashes with LTTE.
Boat with seven Sri Lankan fishermen aboard is missing in recent cyclone that hit Bangladesh.
Victories on the battle field must be strengthened through political solution to the northeast conflict, says General Ratwatte.
